description: Check workspace/session authentication and readiness, plus common setup errors. Use when setup, auth, or project binding is in doubt; use hydracept_job_status for a specific execution. Does not execute capabilities or spend money. Hosted requires bearer (WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED when missing); stdio checks local project binding. Not a substitute for hydracept_capabilities. Returns: Workspace/session authentication and readiness diagnostics for the authenticated principal. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED when bearer is missing on hosted MCP.

refresh.description: Stdio: when true, also verify session over the network. Ignored on hosted MCP.
